ideas.title: Chip a stone until it sings
ideas.goal: the player picks up a flat stone on the beach and chips it with a pebble, bit by bit, knocking between chips: every chip changes the note, and they tune a row of stones into a xylophone the friends then play. Fun because nothing says how a shape sounds: you learn it by ear.
ideas.idea: Knock project's next step: the stone is voxels (physics/modes.jl, checked against beam theory today), a chip removes the voxels under the hit and re-solves the modes (under a second), the knock plays the new spectrum. Watching: a stone that rings lower each time a flake flies off.
ideas.form: plugin (chip key in Jump in, the stone row on the beach), film with sound of one stone being tuned

ideas.title: Soap bubbles with real film colours
ideas.goal: the player blows soap bubbles from a ring (hold to blow slowly for a big one, fast for a stream of small ones); the breeze carries them, friends chase and pop them, a bubble that lands on grass sits there wobbling. Fun to blow the biggest one that survives.
ideas.idea: Each bubble is a thin water shell: buoyancy vs film weight, drag, a breathing wobble, and a film that thins from the top until it pops. In the tracer the colours are real thin-film interference (a Hikari thin-film material: thickness sets the colour bands, swirling black at the top before the pop).
ideas.form: Hikari thin-film material (added to dev/Hikari if missing) + plugin (B in Jump in), traced close-up film

ideas.title: Writing with the sun
ideas.goal: the player holds a magnifying glass up to the sun and burns marks into a plank, a dry leaf or a log: tilt and height focus the spot; too far it only warms, sharp it smokes and chars, a dry leaf pile catches fire. Fun to write your name in a fence.
ideas.idea: The lens is real optics: rays from the sun through the lens find the spot size, its power density heats the wood texel by texel (heat equation in the plank), char darkens the texture for good, smoke above the hot spot. Traced, the caustic spot is the lens's own.
ideas.form: plugin with a persistent burnt texture, traced film of a word burnt into the cottage fence

ideas.title: Sky lanterns
ideas.goal: at dusk the player lights a paper lantern, holds it until the air inside is hot enough and lets go: too early it sinks, just right it rises over the sea; the friends release theirs, and wind carries the whole flock. Fun to feel the moment it is ready.
ideas.idea: Ideal-gas buoyancy: the flame heats the air inside, the lantern lifts when hot air weight plus paper is less than the air it displaces; it cools as the fuel runs out and drifts down far out at sea. Each lantern is one warm light (a few dozen, not hundreds).
ideas.form: plugin (dusk key), traced night film from the beach

ideas.title: Dam the stream
ideas.goal: the player rolls stones and sticks into the island's stream to bend it: water backs up, finds a new way, floods the garden or fills a pond the friends swim in. Fun because water always finds the way you did not plan.
ideas.idea: A shallow-water simulation on the GPU over the terrain (Maelstrom or a KA height field), stones as obstacles, overflow, a dam that leaks and gives way under the pressure behind it.
ideas.form: plugin with a GPU water grid, film of a dam breaking

ideas.title: Footprints in mud
ideas.goal: after rain the path turns to mud: everyone who walks leaves prints that fill with water, heavy friends sink deeper, the player can follow anyone's trail across the island. Fun to track and to stomp.
ideas.idea: A deformable ground height field under the path: each foot pushes soil by its weight (a plastic soil model), puddles gather in prints, the sun dries them over hours.
ideas.form: engine height field + plugin, raster in the live game, traced close-up

ideas.title: Fold a paper plane
ideas.goal: the player folds a paper plane from a notebook page (nose angle, wing bend), throws it, and bends the tail up or down until it glides across the meadow instead of diving. Fun to tune until it flies far.
ideas.idea: Rigid plate aerodynamics (paperpage.jl) for a folded shape: lift and pitching moment from the folds, the elevator bend trims it. The flight path is drawn by the physics, a stall shows.
ideas.form: plugin with a fold menu, film of three throws

ideas.title: Fell a tree
ideas.goal: the player chops a tree with an axe: where they cut the notch decides where it falls, the hinge holds it while it leans, and it crashes, bounces and rolls. Fun to drop it exactly where you want.
ideas.idea: Wood as a fibre-direction material: a notch and back cut leave a hinge that bends and breaks (PrintSim body with a breaking joint), the fall a rigid body against the ground.
ideas.form: plugin, film of a tree going down

ideas.title: Sand castles the tide takes
ideas.goal: the player builds with wet sand on the beach, towers and walls, and the evening tide comes in and takes them; dry sand slides, wet sand stands. Fun to build one that outlasts the tide.
ideas.idea: Granular sand with water content: cohesion from wetness (MPM or discrete grains on the GPU), the tide wets the bottom and the walls slump.

ideas.title: A rope swing over the pond
ideas.goal: the player grabs a rope tied to a branch above the lily pond and pumps by leaning, swinging higher each time, and lets go at the top to splash as far as they can. Fun to time the release.
ideas.idea: A pendulum on a verlet rope, pumping by moving the body's centre of mass, release into a ballistic flight and a real splash.
ideas.form: plugin, film of one big splash
